plain: Local internet provider Fiber Media told customers that DDoS attacks, which flood a line with fake traffic, caused some short outages. It says customer data is safe and the attacks no longer cause outages.
summary: TELKO.in reports that Fiber Media, a local internet provider in the Lublin region, told customers it was hit by a DDoS attack in recent days. The operator attributes brief outages for some customers over recent weeks to such attacks, says customer data and devices are safe and says it has added safeguards. According to Fiber Media, a prosecutor's office is handling the case.
title: Fiber Media, a Lublin-region internet provider, says DDoS attacks caused brief outages for some customers
